scope: All three ordinary body-flow citation keys, every citation-bearing claim, canonical bibliography metadata, nearby support, bibliography coverage, and the complete publication source inventory were checked. The bounded comparison makes no novelty or priority certification.
citation_audit_method: two-stage frozen claim extraction followed by manual primary-source verification using the official arXiv record and version-1 PDF, the official MathNet journal record, and the official Preprints.org version-1 full text; mandatory academic search-query variants were replayed on 2026-09-10 UTC
